sections.heading: Lucretia
sections.original:
Tace, Lucretia; ferrum in manu est.
Per hunc castissimum ante regiam iniuriam sanguinem iuro.
sections.translation:
Be silent, Lucretia; a sword is in my hand.
By this blood, most chaste before the royal wrong, I swear.

readers_note: A short project-authored conformance excerpt transcribed from the public-domain Latin text of Livy 1.58-59; it is not qualification gold.
